_about: Machine-readable script for the Desert Ranger audio build. Source: docs/AUDIO-PLAN-AMBIENCE-RADIO.md (sections B, D, E) on prototype-m1. 'text' is the exact script line (used for display and the Whisper word-check); 'tts_text' (when present) is the TTS input with numbers and ten-codes spelled out; 'pronunciations' (top level) is the SHARED respelling table (whole-word, case-insensitive): gen_lines.py substitutes it into the TTS text of EVERY generation, and qa_check.py accepts either the written word or the respelling when Whisper listens; Whisper never has to hear the respelling spelled out; an ALL-CAPS respelling (e.g. OYA) is sent Title-Cased (Oya, Vaya-See-Toe) because Chatterbox spells all-caps words letter by letter; add a word there once and every line using it is covered on the next regeneration. 'pronounce' (when present) holds extra per-line respellings applied only on --pron retakes (before the shared table); 'whisper_ignore' lists Latin words the word-check skips. 'square' is the board index 0-51 or null. 'cue' is the plan's cue tag (radio/cheer/aww) or 'chatter'. 'phase' maps to docs/HANDOFF-CLAUDE-AUDIO.md. 'treatment' = radio (radio DSP chain) | clean (in-person voice) | crowd (layered group). 'file' is relative to desertranger/audio/. 'max_sec' is the post-trim voice-length ceiling. Do not edit 'text' without logging the change in docs/AUDIO-BUILD-LOG.md. Openers are delivered with a slight upward 'continuing' intonation so a place name can follow. proposed_phrase=true marks place phrases for action squares that the user should review. Square names: see 'squares'; exchange titles: see 'chatter_exchanges'. 'qa_text' (optional, per line) is the reference the Whisper word-check compares against instead of 'text' (use it when the TTS is deliberately stylised, e.g. the drawn-out R55 call sign; 'text' stays the displayed/shipped script). 'gen' (optional, per line) holds Chatterbox settings {ex, cfg} used for that line when --ex/--cfg are not given on the command line (e.g. slower pacing for the drawn-out R55 lines). 'lead_sfx' (optional) names a synthesized WAV in audio-work/master (made by tools/audio/make_nudge.py) that master.py places before the voice (nudge-01); 'lead_gap' (s, default 0.12) is the silence between it and the voice and 'tail_pad' (s) trailing silence. 'wave2' (optional, per line) marks a clip re-recorded or added in Wave 2: {change, old_text, old_tts, old_sec}; tools/audio/build_review.py uses it for the 'Changed in Wave 2' section of review.html (old text -> new text, spoken form, old vs new length).
